# Revise definition of cardiac septum (UBERON:0002099)

Addresses issue #3003.
issue_comment:
Thanks for the suggestion. The definition of `cardiac septum` (UBERON:0002099) has been revised so it now correctly encompasses all current child classes (interatrial, interventricular, atrioventricular, outflow tract, and aortico-pulmonary spiral septa).

I chose a slightly different wording from the one in the issue body, because the proposed text still characterized the structure as "thin membranous" — that does not apply to the interventricular septum (thick and muscular) or to the outflow tract / AV septa. The new wording is therefore neutral about thickness and composition, matching what the more specific child terms describe.

Changes committed in PR #<NN>.
